description: This file defines the class ConstraintViolationBuilder, which implements a builder pattern for creating validation constraint violations within Drupal, utilizing Symfony Validator components.

classes.name: ConstraintViolationBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating and managing validation constraint violations, integrating with Symfony Validator components within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the builder with violation list, constraint, message, parameters, root, property path, invalid value, translator, and optional translation domain.

methods.name: atPath
methods.description: Appends a given path segment to the current property path for the violation.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Sets a specific parameter key-value pair for the violation message.

methods.name: setParameters
methods.description: Replaces all message parameters with the provided array.

methods.name: setTranslationDomain
methods.description: Sets the translation domain for message translation.

methods.name: setInvalidValue
methods.description: Sets the invalid value associated with the violation.

methods.name: setPlural
methods.description: Sets the pluralization number for the violation message.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets an optional code for the violation.

methods.name: setCause
methods.description: Sets the cause of the violation.

methods.name: addViolation
methods.description: Translates the message and adds a new ConstraintViolation to the violations list.

methods.name: disableTranslation
methods.description: Disables translation by setting the translation domain to FALSE.
